svg.desc: Three task comparisons separate a reach cue from its destination, hand motion from tool closure, and grasping from eating or placing. In each, the compared epoch is shaded; the right-hand column gives the aspect of the action goal examined, what is held constant or similar, what is varied, the instruction, tool constraint, or task context, and the neural measure. Schematic; no data.

g.text: hand target and cue: green = pro, blue = anti
planned reach destination (not shown on screen)
Goal: where the hand will go
Goal: what the grasp is for
